notes: ἐν αὐτῇ → *there* taken as one noncompositional unit headed on the governed pronoun under rule 45, rule 94's single-English-word precondition being met; rule 81's portmanteau reading is unavailable, *there* spelling no *-in* or *-by*.
ἐγγύς keeps its trailing *unto*, the ASV giving the governed name no determiner for the article to anchor (rules 101 and 71), and heads on *nigh*.
